FEAT-5-S171.title: Pydantic Validation Enforcement for Tool Inputs
FEAT-5-S171.description: Enforce strict validation of all incoming tool arguments against their registered Pydantic models, rejecting invalid payloads before execution and returning structured validation errors to the agent loop.

FEAT-5-S172.title: Allowlist Enforcement for Tool Name Resolution
FEAT-5-S172.description: Implement strict allowlist checks during tool dispatch to ensure only registered tool names can be executed, with explicit rejection and logging of any unauthorized tool invocation attempts.

FEAT-5-S173.title: Unit Tests for Tool Routing and Validation Paths
FEAT-5-S173.description: Expand unit test coverage to include allowlist enforcement, Pydantic validation failures, successful tool execution, and error handling paths within the tool router.

FEAT-5-S174.title: End-to-End Tool Use Integration with Agent Loop
FEAT-5-S174.description: Validate full integration of tool routing within the Anthropic tool_use loop, ensuring tool calls are correctly parsed, dispatched, validated, and returned in the expected format for continued agent reasoning.
